summary: Explains full closed looping (FCL): letting AAPS handle meals without user boluses or carb entries, using UAM and Automation rules that raise the profile percentage when a meal-related glucose rise is detected. The reader checks the prerequisites, learns which meals and situations are hard, builds and orders the Automation rules, and troubleshoots highs and lows. Most of the page is therapy advice; the app labels are mainly Automation fields and SMB preferences.
